hero.description: A travel company passionate about creating meaningful journeys, unforgettable experiences and stories that stay with you forever.

story.paragraph1: JJ Travels was founded with a simple belief — travel changes the way we see the world. What began as a passion for exploration has grown into a trusted travel partner for individuals, families and groups across destinations worldwide.
story.paragraph2: We believe luxury is not just five-star accommodations; it is the feeling of absolute freedom, effortless coordination, and arriving as welcome guests rather than mere tourists.

journeyMilestones.title: The Founding Vision
journeyMilestones.description: Established with a dedicated mission to craft authentic, transparent travel experiences that bypass mass-tourism clichés.

journeyMilestones.title: 24/7 Concierge Pioneer
journeyMilestones.description: Introduced direct WhatsApp-linked on-ground coordination with coordinators Joby & Akhil, ensuring every traveler has immediate real-time support.

journeyMilestones.title: Global Alpine & Mediterranean Expansion
journeyMilestones.description: Partnered with premier chalets and private yacht fleets across Switzerland, Italy, Greece, and the UAE for exclusive client privileges.

journeyMilestones.title: Excellence in Bespoke Travel
journeyMilestones.description: Recognized for uncompromising integrity and personalized travel curation, serving discerning individuals, families, and private groups worldwide.

coreValues.title: Authentic Experiences
coreValues.subtitle: Integrity
coreValues.description: Real places, real people and real stories. We curate journeys that reveal the true culture, heritage, and atmosphere of each destination.

coreValues.title: Trust & Reliability
coreValues.subtitle: Transparency
coreValues.description: Transparent planning built on dependable assistance and meticulous attention to every single flight, transfer, and hotel booking.

coreValues.title: Personalized Plans
coreValues.subtitle: Individuality
coreValues.description: Every traveler is unique. We craft each itinerary around your individual pace, aesthetic tastes, and dream experiences.

coreValues.title: Quality Support
coreValues.subtitle: Dedication
coreValues.description: With you at every step of the journey. 24/7 proactive concierge care from departure through to your safe homecoming.

promise.description: To bring you closer to the world with curated trips, seamless planning and experiences you'll always cherish.
